annotations.title: USDA rural eligibility for an address

description: Checks one US street address against USDA Rural Development's ineligible-area map for its single family and multifamily housing programs (which governs Section 538): eligible or not on the current map, the proposed 2020-census map and the previous map, plus the matched address, county and place (Census Bureau geocoder, or OpenStreetMap and the FCC when Census does not answer).

address.description: Street address with city and state or ZIP, e.g. "100 Main St, Anamosa, IA 52205".

name: check_rural_eligibility
title: USDA rural eligibility for an address
